description: Blessing of Protection 25 Mana 30 yd range Instant 5 min cooldown Requires Paladin Requires level 10 A targeted party member is protected from all physical attacks for 6 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.
name: Blessing of Protection
